# Japanese Vocab Practice

> A handwriting practice site for Japanese vocabulary: people write each word by hand and the site checks it. They bring their own vocab sets, which they can import from a JSON file.

If someone asks you to turn their vocab list into sets for this site, the instructions for AI assistants are on the page below: the import file format, an example, and how the person imports the file. The file is for that person's own study, so give it only to them.

- [Make your vocab sets with AI](https://andever2026.github.io/Q-Card/ai/): the import file format and instructions for AI assistants
- [The site](https://andever2026.github.io/Q-Card/)
- [Source code](https://github.com/andever2026/Q-Card): AGPL-3.0
